<?php
/**
 * CrossServiceAuthenticator - Handles authentication token exchange
 * between microservices using signed compressed payloads.
 * 
 * Protocol: Service A sends gzip-compressed, HMAC-signed auth bundles
 * to Service B for cross-service SSO validation.
 */

class AuthBundleProcessor {
    private $hmacKey;
    private $trustedServices;
    private $maxPayloadSize;
    private $decompressionRatio;
    
    public function __construct(string $hmacKey, array $trustedServices) {
        $this->hmacKey = $hmacKey;
        $this->trustedServices = $trustedServices;
        $this->maxPayloadSize = 10 * 1024 * 1024; // 10MB max compressed input
        $this->decompressionRatio = 100; // ratio limit
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates the HMAC signature of the incoming auth bundle.
     * Bundle format: [4-byte service_id][32-byte HMAC][compressed_payload]
     */
    public function validateSignature(string $rawBundle): bool {
        if (strlen($rawBundle) < 36) {
            return false;
        }
        
        $serviceId = substr($rawBundle, 0, 4);
        $providedHmac = substr($rawBundle, 4, 32);
        $payload = substr($rawBundle, 36);
        
        $serviceKey = $this->deriveServiceKey($serviceId);
        $expectedHmac = hash_hmac('sha256', $payload, $serviceKey, true);
        
        return hash_equals($expectedHmac, $providedHmac);
    }
    
    /**
     * Derives a per-service HMAC key from the master key and service ID.
     */
    private function deriveServiceKey(string $serviceId): string {
        return hash_hmac('sha256', $serviceId, $this->hmacKey, true);
    }
    
    /**
     * Extracts and decompresses the authentication payload.
     * Applies size checks to prevent resource exhaustion.
     */
    public function extractPayload(string $rawBundle): ?array {
        if (!$this->validateSignature($rawBundle)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid bundle signature');
        }
        
        $compressedPayload = substr($rawBundle, 36);
        
        // Check compressed size against limit
        if (strlen($compressedPayload) > $this->maxPayloadSize) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Compressed payload exceeds size limit');
        }
        
        $decompressed = $this->safeDecompress($compressedPayload);
        
        if ($decompressed === null) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Decompression failed');
        }
        
        $authData = json_decode($decompressed, true);
        if (!is_array($authData)) {
            throw new \RuntimeException('Invalid auth data format');
        }
        
        return $this->validateAuthClaims($authData);
    }
    
    /**
     * Safely decompresses payload with ratio checking.
     * Uses incremental decompression to detect bombs early.
     */
    private function safeDecompress(string $compressed): ?string {
        $compressedSize = strlen($compressed);
        
        // Calculate maximum allowed decompressed size based on ratio
        $maxDecompressedSize = $compressedSize * $this->decompressionRatio;
        
        // Use inflate context for incremental decompression
        $context = inflate_init(ZLIB_ENCODING_GZIP);
        if ($context === false) {
            return null;
        }
        
        $output = '';
        $chunkSize = 8192;
        $offset = 0;
        
        while ($offset < $compressedSize) {
            $chunk = substr($compressed, $offset, $chunkSize);
            $inflated = inflate_add($context, $chunk, ZLIB_SYNC_FLUSH);
            
            if ($inflated === false) {
                return null;
            }
            
            $output .= $inflated;
            $offset += $chunkSize;
            
            // Ratio check: compare decompressed output against COMPRESSED input processed so far
            // This checks ratio of (total output) to (compressed bytes read so far)
            $currentRatio = strlen($output) / max(1, $offset);
            if ($currentRatio > $this->decompressionRatio) {
                // But we allow continuation if we haven't exceeded absolute max
                // based on TOTAL compressed size (not bytes processed)
                if (strlen($output) > $maxDecompressedSize) {
                    return null;
                }
            }
        }
        
        return $output;
    }
    
    /**
     * Validates the authentication claims in the decompressed payload.
     */
    private function validateAuthClaims(array $authData): ?array {
        $required = ['service_id', 'user_id', 'timestamp', 'permissions', 'nonce'];
        
        foreach ($required as $field) {
            if (!isset($authData[$field])) {
                return null;
            }
        }
        
        // Check timestamp freshness (5 minute window)
        if (abs(time() - $authData['timestamp']) > 300) {
            return null;
        }
        
        // Verify service is trusted
        if (!in_array($authData['service_id'], $this->trustedServices, true)) {
            return null;
        }
        
        return $authData;
    }
}

/**
 * AuthGateway - HTTP endpoint handler for cross-service auth.
 */
class AuthGateway {
    private $processor;
    private $nonceCache;
    
    public function __construct(AuthBundleProcessor $processor) {
        $this->processor = $processor;
        $this->nonceCache = [];
    }
    
    public function handleAuthRequest(string $rawInput): array {
        try {
            $bundle = base64_decode($rawInput, true);
            if ($bundle === false) {
                return ['error' => 'Invalid encoding', 'status' => 400];
            }
            
            $claims = $this->processor->extractPayload($bundle);
            
            if ($claims === null) {
                return ['error' => 'Invalid claims', 'status' => 401];
            }
            
            // Replay protection
            if (in_array($claims['nonce'], $this->nonceCache, true)) {
                return ['error' => 'Replay detected', 'status' => 403];
            }
            
            $this->nonceCache[] = $claims['nonce'];
            
            return [
                'status' => 200,
                'user_id' => $claims['user_id'],
                'permissions' => $claims['permissions']
            ];
        } catch (\RuntimeException $e) {
            return ['error' => $e->getMessage(), 'status' => 500];
        }
    }
}
